pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Heterogeneous dark brown regions characterized by smooth pixel gradients at the edges, transitioning from dark centers to lighter boundaries. The geometry is defined by irregular multi-sided polygons with variable spatial area and soft angularity.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous negative-space topological graph composed of light-toned pixels. The network contains distinct tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes where corridors of varying pixel thickness intersect across the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette visible along the upper neck profile, formed by short, dark, vertically-oriented pixel clusters protruding against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: A small, dark, distinctively shaped object is perched on the mid-dorsal ridge, causing localized occlusion of the underlying pelage pattern.
